verdict.rationale: Crossplane supports the least-privilege half of this story. It inherits Kubernetes RBAC [docs-17, docs-30] and exposes declarative APIs that it says 'humans, automation, and AI systems can safely act on' [docs-16]. A community comment adds that users are only given permission at the interface they interact with [comm-8]. A plan-like preview exists through CLI rendering of compositions without a cluster [docs-7], but nothing shows a review or approval gate that blocks an agent from applying unapproved changes; the one GitOps mention [comm-9] is a question, not evidence. Missing for 10: a documented approval/review gate before apply, an explicit plan/diff of changes to real resources, agent-specific credential-scoping guidance, and independent corroboration.
